mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in residential investment (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening housing demand that reduces consumer spending momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL indicate disinflationary monetary policy that lowers real rates and stabilizes growth expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through joint rate-inflation dynamics.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), monthly nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 200k signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0% periods, PAYEMS > 200k monthly increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO decline >0.5% month-over-month instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates sustained consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of RSAFS rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market expansion that boosts consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through joint demand dynamics.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 100.5), a monthly INDPRO decline exceeding 0.3% signals early manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO > 100.5 periods, a decline >0.3% month-over-month fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
